title: Railway lines in Northern Ireland: the NIR network (Translink)
referencePeriod: NIR railway network as published on OpenDataNI, 21 September 2015
coverage: Northern Ireland: the NIR network's route lines (sidings left out). Great Britain: not included (no open, official railway line dataset in this build)
attribution: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0. Source: Translink (NI Railways), OpenDataNI

retrieval.method: Read offline from the committed shapefile (fetch-reference --set stage6)
retrieval.notes: Route lines (ROUTE_TYPE 'Passenger'), heights dropped, simplified at 10 m in TM75 Irish Grid (EPSG:29903), WGS84 to 5 decimals. Lines show where the railway runs, not services or freight.
